title: Legal Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!



⚠️Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.

Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!



⚠️Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: IT Service Desk - Advanced English
description:
What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.


What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory


You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With


  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)



Why join us?

At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.


We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in the workplace.

At Infios, we believe that inclusion is a fundamental cornerstone of our success. We are committed to creating a safe and welcoming environment where every individual’s unique experiences and perspectives are valued—whether they look, think, move, believe, or love differently.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, religion, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability during the recruiting process, please let us know at

description:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.

  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.

  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Consultor ABAP WorkFlow
description:
A Softtek está em busca de Consultor SAP ABAP WorkFlow para fazer parte do nosso time de AMS!


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (reports, includes, classes e function modules).
  • Atuar com SAP Workflow, realizando:
  • Análise e correção de workflows existentes
  • Criação e ajustes de Templates de Workflow (WS)
  • Configuração e manutenção de Tasks (TS)
  • Trabalho com Business Objects (BOR)
  • Debug e troubleshooting de workflows (eventos, tarefas e agentes)
  • Trabalhar com user exits, BAdIs e enhancements.
  • Atuar no suporte e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.
  • Participar de análises técnicas e funcionais junto às áreas de negócio.
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e apoiar testes unitários e integrados.
  • Desenvolver soluções ABAP e demandas de Workflow para equipe AMS do projeto.


Responsabilidades

  • Implementar melhorias técnicas e evolutivas em ABAP e Workflow.
  • Garantir estabilidade e performance das soluções implementadas.
  • Atuar na sustentação e suporte contínuo das aplicações.
  • Colaborar com times funcionais e técnicos para levantamento de requisitos.


Tipo de Alocação: Remoto.


A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante.

Independentemente da sua ,etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer.


Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!


Quer saber mais? Acesse:

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (2 Openings)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


We are hiring two Senior Designers to support a complex, enterprise-scale environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, navigates sophisticated stakeholder ecosystems, and drives design across overlapping product areas.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end product design (problem framing → user flows → interaction patterns → UI → validation)
  • Translate ambiguous or messy requirements into clear UX direction and prioritized scope
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to drive alignment and decision-making
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to plan increments and define trade-offs
  • Produce high-quality Figma deliverables (journeys, IA, wireframes, prototypes, specifications)
  • Coach and support mid-level designers when needed


Must-Have Requirements

  • Expert-level Figma execution (this is non-negotiable)
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
  • Experience working in large, complex, and robust enterprise environments
  • Background in regulated, technical, or high-compliance industries
  • Ability to operate across UX and visual design
  • Working knowledge of research methodologies


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Healthcare or Financial Services
  • Analytics background
  • Experience with workshop tools (Miro, FigJam)
  • Service blueprinting experience

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Analista Sr Infraestrutura AWS e Redes (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Local: 100% Remoto

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Sênior de Infraestrutura com forte atuação em Cloud (AWS) e ambientes On‑Premise , com conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança de Redes , Firewalls, Middleware e ambientes de missão crítica. Será responsável por suportar ambientes híbridos, aplicações em microsserviços e produtos Cloud‑native, além de atuar na sustentação, deploys, provisionamento e segurança da infraestrutura.

A atuação envolve contato com equipes de Segurança, DevOps e Integração, além de participação em projetos de desmobilização, melhorias de arquitetura e manutenção de ambientes complexos.


Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes AWS e On‑Premise .
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a segurança de redes , incluindo análise, configuração e troubleshooting de firewalls .
  • Suporte e manutenção em ambientes de infraestrutura em conjunto com as equipes internas.
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança , configurações de rede, provisionamento, acessos e governança de ambientes.
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de ambientes com microsserviços (sobretudo em AWS).
  • Realização de deploys, sustentação de ambientes e apoio à fábrica de integração (MuleSoft e Kafka).
  • Administração e suporte a servidores Linux e Windows (predominância Linux).
  • Colaboração com o time de Segurança para demandas de segurança aplicável (patches, controles, ajustes).
  • Interface com o time de DevOps para discussões técnicas.
  • Suporte de segundo nível, contando com apoio do CSC para atividades de N1.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência em Infraestrutura AWS (EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, Security Groups, CloudWatch etc.).
  • Experiência com ambientes On‑Premise (redes, servidores, virtualização).
  • Domínio em Segurança de Redes , incluindo Firewall e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimentos em Linux (principal) e Windows Server .
  • Conhecimento de Storage , provisionamento, acessos, e governança.
  • Experiência com aplicação de patches de segurança


  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais
  • Experiência com MuleSoft .
  • Entendimento geral de práticas DevOps .
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de desmobilização/mobilização de sistemas , especialmente envolvendo ERPs.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce and technology solutions provider delivering innovative, data-driven services to enterprise clients worldwide. We combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help organizations modernize systems, optimize performance, and unlock the value of their data. Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

title: Especialista jurídico
description:
Vaga afirmativa para PCD e 40+


Especialista Jurídico


Qualidade para Vida - Esta é a visão de negócio da GMReis, que há mais de 25 anos desenvolve, produz e comercializa sua linha de produtos, classificada em próteses ortopédicas.

A inovação tecnológica aliada à qualidade dos produtos são os valores buscados diariamente na GMReis para que a expectativa dos clientes, médicos e pacientes, seja plenamente atendida com segurança e eficácia.

A GMReis está sediada em Campinas/SP em uma área de 6.000 m², dentro de um moderno parque tecnológico, com equipamentos de produção e análise metrológica de última geração, e uma área limpa ISO classe 8 de 800 m² onde são fabricados enxertos ósseos e implantes biorreabsorvíveis.


Atuação Presencial


Horário: Segunda a Quinta 07:30h as 17:30 e sexta 07:30h as 16:30h.


Área: Jurídico

Reporte: CEO

Regime: CLT


Descrição do Cargo

Atuar como Especialista Jurídico, prestando apoio técnico direto ao CEO, com foco na leitura, análise e revisão de contratos empresariais, inclusive em língua inglesa, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e suporte à tomada de decisão da Diretoria.

Atuar como ponto focal jurídico da empresa, realizando análises jurídicas preliminares e intermediando, de forma técnica, as demandas junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas.


Principais Atividades:

  • Ler, analisar e revisar contratos empresariais, inclusive contratos redigidos em inglês, identificando riscos, inconsistências e pontos de atenção;


  • Prestar suporte jurídico direto ao CEO em temas contratuais e decisões estratégicas;


  • Atuar como interface técnica junto a escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas, alinhando escopo, análises e encaminhamentos;


  • Realizar análises jurídicas preliminares nas áreas contratual, societária, tributária e trabalhista, direcionando demandas às consultorias especializadas quando necessário;


  • Acompanhar prazos, vigências, renovações e aditivos contratuais, avaliando impactos jurídicos e financeiros;


  • Contribuir para a padronização de instrumentos contratuais, em conjunto com o jurídico externo;


  • Garantir controle, organização e rastreabilidade dos contratos e demandas jurídicas da empresa;


  • Apoiar áreas internas em temas jurídicos, conforme diretrizes da Diretoria.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Direito;


  • OAB ativa;


  • Experiência prática com contratos empresariais;


  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura, interpretação e análise de contratos em inglês;


  • Vivência em interface com escritórios e consultorias jurídicas externas;


  • Perfil técnico, analítico e criterioso;


  • Discrição, ética profissional e capacidade de atuação próxima à alta liderança.


  • Residir em Campinas ou Sumaré, Paulínia, Hortolândia ou Valinhos.


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível
  • Convênio médico coparticipativo (para o colaborador (a)
  • Convênio odontológico para colaborador e dependentes
  • Parceria com a faculdade Esamc descontos de até 50% na mensalidade para graduações e tecnólogos e 20% para MBA.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (2 Openings)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


We are hiring two Senior Designers to support a complex, enterprise-scale environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, navigates sophisticated stakeholder ecosystems, and drives design across overlapping product areas.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end product design (problem framing → user flows → interaction patterns → UI → validation)
  • Translate ambiguous or messy requirements into clear UX direction and prioritized scope
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to drive alignment and decision-making
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to plan increments and define trade-offs
  • Produce high-quality Figma deliverables (journeys, IA, wireframes, prototypes, specifications)
  • Coach and support mid-level designers when needed


Must-Have Requirements

  • Expert-level Figma execution (this is non-negotiable)
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
  • Experience working in large, complex, and robust enterprise environments
  • Background in regulated, technical, or high-compliance industries
  • Ability to operate across UX and visual design
  • Working knowledge of research methodologies


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Healthcare or Financial Services
  • Analytics background

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.

  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.

  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.

Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado

  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).

  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).

  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)

  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:


  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)

  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Analista Contábil Sr
description:
Requisitos Técnicos

· Experiência sólida (mínimo 5 anos) em contabilidade geral, fechamento mensal e demonstrações financeiras.

· Domínio de normas CPC/IFRS e legislação societária brasileira.

· Conhecimento avançado em Excel (fórmulas, Tabelas Dinâmicas, Power Query) e ERP (QuickBooks, TOTVS, ou similar).

· Experiência em conciliar intercompany, ativos fixos, provisões, ajustes de resultado e fechamento contábil completo.

· Inglês Fluente.

.Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365


Responsabilidades Principais

· Assegurar processos e atividades de contas a pagar e contas a receber

· Assegurar as conciliações contábeis completas e revisões de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.

· Elaborar e analisar demonstrações contábeis (Balanço, DRE, DFC).

· Controlar e contabilizar provisões, rateios e lançamentos manuais complexos.

· Assegurar a correta classificação contábil e a aderência ao plano de contas corporativo.

· Apoiar a auditoria externas.

· Revisar lançamentos de folha, ativos fixos, intercompany, impostos e custos.

· Realizar fechamento contábil mensal e reconciliações entre contabilidade e fiscal.

· Manter interface constante com áreas Financeira, Fiscal, RH, Contas a Pagar/Receber.

· Garantir conformidade com CPCs (ex: CPC 00, 27, 04, 25, 32, 46, 48, 47, 15) e princípios IFRS.

· Apoiar a entrega e revisão das obrigações acessórias (ECD, ECF, DCTF, DIRF, etc.).

title: Analista Sr Infraestrutura AWS e Redes (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Local: 100% Remoto

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Sênior de Infraestrutura com forte atuação em Cloud (AWS) e ambientes On‑Premise , com conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança de Redes , Firewalls, Middleware e ambientes de missão crítica. Será responsável por suportar ambientes híbridos, aplicações em microsserviços e produtos Cloud‑native, além de atuar na sustentação, deploys, provisionamento e segurança da infraestrutura.

A atuação envolve contato com equipes de Segurança, DevOps e Integração, além de participação em projetos de desmobilização, melhorias de arquitetura e manutenção de ambientes complexos.


Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes AWS e On‑Premise .
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a segurança de redes , incluindo análise, configuração e troubleshooting de firewalls .
  • Suporte e manutenção em ambientes de infraestrutura em conjunto com as equipes internas.
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança , configurações de rede, provisionamento, acessos e governança de ambientes.
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de ambientes com microsserviços (sobretudo em AWS).
  • Realização de deploys, sustentação de ambientes e apoio à fábrica de integração (MuleSoft e Kafka).
  • Administração e suporte a servidores Linux e Windows (predominância Linux).
  • Colaboração com o time de Segurança para demandas de segurança aplicável (patches, controles, ajustes).
  • Interface com o time de DevOps para discussões técnicas.
  • Suporte de segundo nível, contando com apoio do CSC para atividades de N1.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência em Infraestrutura AWS (EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, Security Groups, CloudWatch etc.).
  • Experiência com ambientes On‑Premise (redes, servidores, virtualização).
  • Domínio em Segurança de Redes , incluindo Firewall e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimentos em Linux (principal) e Windows Server .
  • Conhecimento de Storage , provisionamento, acessos, e governança.
  • Experiência com aplicação de patches de segurança


  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais
  • Experiência com MuleSoft .
  • Entendimento geral de práticas DevOps .
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de desmobilização/mobilização de sistemas , especialmente envolvendo ERPs.

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: IT Service Desk - Advanced English
description:
What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.


What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory


You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With


  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)



Why join us?

At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.


We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in the workplace.

At Infios, we believe that inclusion is a fundamental cornerstone of our success. We are committed to creating a safe and welcoming environment where every individual’s unique experiences and perspectives are valued—whether they look, think, move, believe, or love differently.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, religion, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability during the recruiting process, please let us know at

Applications must be submitted via our career site.
